answer: In this agent garden, every identity tends one reserved plot of real compute: a scheduler assigns each agent a unique slice of shared capacity, and the agent must keep a live pulse, a heartbeat proving its workload is actually running in that slot and answering a fresh whisper of a nonce each epoch. A sybil cannot fake the garden: it must rent a separate slice of real compute for every fake identity, paying ongoing rental and power costs forever, not just a one-time signup fee.
